name: Notes
description: Personal notes with folders, tags, full-text search, and trash management for your workspace.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_notes
tools.description: Note statistics: total count, pinned, trash, folders, recent notes with folder.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes (paginated). Returns up to `limit` rows per call (max 200). If `has_more` is true, call again with `offset=offset+limit` to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Max notes per page (1-200). Use offset to paginate.
limit.title: Limit

folder_id.description: Filter by folder — accepts folder UUID or folder name (auto-resolved).
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tags.description: Filter by tag names (AND-match: a note must have all listed tags).
tags.title: Tags

is_archived.description: Filter by archive status. None (default) = active notes only. True = archived notes only. False = explicitly active only.
is_archived.title: Is Archived

NoteListItem.description: Slim SDL note entity for list results.
NoteListItem.title: NoteListItem

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Get full content of a note by ID.

Ref.description:
Lightweight reference to another entity (parent/related/list-item/cross-app).

Carries ``title`` so the kernel can render/resolve without a second lookup.
Ref.title: Ref

return_schema.description:
Full SDL note entity. id=note_id (UUID), title=note title, kind="note".
sdl.Bodied provides: body (content), body_format.
sdl.Categorized provides: tags.
return_schema.title: NoteEntity

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note with title, content, tags, and optional folder.

params_schema.description:
Create a new note.

`title` and `content_text` both have safe defaults — handler-side
normalization decides what to do with empty values rather than
Pydantic rejecting the call. LLMs occasionally pass `content`,
`body`, `text` instead of `content_text` — accepted via aliases.

title.description: Note title. Field name is 'title' — never the folder name.
title.title: Title

content_text.description: Note body text. Field name in tool calls is 'content_text' — never 'content', 'body', or 'text', though those are accepted as aliases.
content_text.title: Content Text

folder_id.description: Folder UUID or folder name — auto-resolved by the handler. Pass the name directly.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

params_schema.title: CreateNoteParams

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update note title, content, tags, or pin status.

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move note to a folder, or root with empty folder_id.

folder_id.description: Target folder UUID or folder name — auto-resolved. Empty string moves to root.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note (moves to trash).

tools.name: permanent_delete_note
tools.description: Permanently delete a note. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_notes_from_folder
tools.description: Delete ALL notes in a folder (bulk). By default moves them to trash; pass permanent=true to permanently delete instead. folder_id accepts a folder UUID OR a folder name — auto-resolved either way.

params_schema.description: Bulk-delete all notes in a folder.

folder_id.description: Folder UUID OR folder name — pass the name directly (e.g. 'химарь'), it will be auto-resolved to UUID. Do NOT leave empty.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

permanent.description: If true, permanently delete all notes (cannot be undone). If false (default), move to trash.
permanent.title: Permanent

params_schema.title: DeleteNotesFromFolderParams

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Full-text search across all notes (paginated). Returns up to `limit` results per call (max 50). If `has_more` is true, call again with `offset=offset+limit` to fetch the next page. Do NOT claim to have searched all notes until `has_more` is false.

limit.description: Max results per page (1-50). Use offset to paginate.
limit.title: Limit

SearchNoteItem.description: Slim SDL note entity for search results.
SearchNoteItem.title: SearchNoteItem

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List all note folders.

params_schema.description: Empty params model for @chat.function handlers that take no business inputs (V17).
params_schema.title: NoParams

FolderEntity.description: SDL folder. id=folder_id (UUID), title=folder name, kind="folder".
FolderEntity.title: FolderEntity

tools.name: resolve_folder
tools.description: Resolve a notes folder by name (case-insensitive). Returns the folder_id plus match_quality ('exact' | 'prefix' | 'contains' | 'none'). Use this INSTEAD of list_folders+manual-match when you only need one folder — it's a single call and gives a stable ID across chain steps.

name.description: Folder name to resolve (case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed). Required.
name.title: Name

return_schema.description: SDL folder. id=folder_id (UUID), title=folder name, kind="folder".
return_schema.title: FolderEntity

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new notes folder.

tools.name: rename_folder
tools.description: Rename an existing notes folder.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Delete a folder (notes move to root).

tools.name: delete_folder_with_contents
tools.description: Delete a folder AND all notes inside it. folder_id accepts a folder UUID OR a folder name — auto-resolved either way. By default moves notes to trash then deletes the folder; pass permanent=true to permanently delete notes instead.

folder_id.description: Folder UUID OR folder name — pass the name directly (e.g. 'химарь'), it will be auto-resolved to UUID. Do NOT leave empty.
folder_id.title: Folder Id

permanent.description: If true, permanently delete all notes (cannot be undone). If false (default), move notes to trash first, then delete folder.
permanent.title: Permanent

tools.name: list_trash
tools.description: List all notes in trash.

params_schema.description: Empty params model for @chat.function handlers that take no business inputs (V17).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: restore_note
tools.description: Restore a note from trash.

tools.name: empty_trash
tools.description: Permanently delete all trashed notes.

params_schema.description: Empty params model for @chat.function handlers that take no business inputs (V17).
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: note_save
tools.description: Save a note field from the editor panel (title, content, tags, folder, pin, archive).

field.description: Field to save: title | content | tags | folder | archive | unarchive | pin
field.title: Field

folder_id.description: Folder UUID or empty string to remove (when field=folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description: Upload a file attachment to a note.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete a file attachment from a note.

tools.name: duplicate_note
tools.description: Duplicate a note — copies title, content, folder, and tags into a new note.

tools.name: export_markdown
tools.description: Export a note as Markdown. Returns the converted content with a download button.
